title: Utility Rate Plan Feed Freshness Gap
dataSources: Utility bills (`utility:bill`), utility meter readings (`utility:meter`), utility rate changes (`utility:rate`), household accounts (`household:account`), utility payments (`utility:payment`).
app: Electric, gas, and water bills, smart-meter readings, household-account records, and utility rate-plan changes streamed to Splunk HEC via portals, CSV exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=utility:rate
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by provider
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>744
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects providers or import paths that have stopped sending utility rate plan data on time.
value: Bill tracking loses trust quickly when one portal or export quietly breaks, so freshness monitoring is essential.
implementation: Set the freshness threshold to your normal statement or tariff refresh cadence.
visualization: Table of providers by hours since last utility event.
grandmaExplanation: It builds when the data feed for utility rate plan has gone stale.
